# shelly Provider

The Shelly provider allows management and configuration of Shelly Gen2 devices via their local API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    shelly = {
      source = "github.com/DonRobo/shelly-provider"
    }
  }
}

provider "shelly" {
  # Device IP has to be set in each resource or data source.

  # Optional: the password of the devices that have authentication on.
  # You can also set it with the SHELLY_PASSWORD environment variable.
  # password = var.shelly_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password of the Shelly devices (HTTP digest authentication, user `admin`). The provider uses it for each device that has authentication on. You can also set it with the `SHELLY_PASSWORD` environment variable. A resource `device_password` overrides this value.
